name: workflow
description: Landing gates, capture, the ticket chain and role discipline: /gemini (independent second-opinion review, challenge, consult, judge), /springclean (adversarial taste-and-proportion panel), /spec-sharpen (multi-pass requirements review until signable, leaving an append-only comment trail so a deferred or killed finding stays reviewable), /build and /digest (the cheap paths across the coordinator/builder/scout boundary), /issue (classified, cross-linked GitHub issue capture), /intake and /pickup (a request becomes an evidence-cited draft ticket with its duplicates and regressions already found, a human signs it, a run whose labels and poll query are proved usable before it polls carries it through a bounded reviewer loop to a PR under a per-route autonomy dial), /worktree (per-ticket isolation with conflicts detected and never resolved), /project-setup (seed the conventions, the role-fence hook and the pickup policy into any repo), plus the role-to-model agents (explorer scouts cheap, builder executes, reviewer sits on landing-gate panels)
